name: az_10_2
description: 2026-10-02 AZ continuation from the 9-30 default run's slot-6 incumbent (gen__azfinal; its rejected/ungated later snapshots are archived in checkpoints/az/archive_0930_default_run/) with SHARPER SEARCH TARGETS: c_puct 2.5 -> 1.5, 4 determinized worlds instead of 8 (1028 sims -> ~257 per world tree), and the root Dirichlet noise drawn ONCE per search and shared by every world (engine/actor change of 10-02). Expert demonstration shards are OFF (they sat 0.5-0.8 nats of policy KL from the net and its value MSE on them exceeded 1.0). Playout cap full_search_frac 0.5 (half the searched roots get the full 1028 sims and record a policy target, half run fast_sims 128 and train value only), with the exhaustive matrix raised from 7 to 12 repeats per unordered pair (660 self-play matches) so the cheaper search buys ~70% more distinct games per slot at about the old slot time, against value memorization. A 5% per-cycle fresh-shard holdout (--holdout-frac default) reports value MSE / policy KL on games never trained on. lr 5e-5 (slots 1-3 ran at 2.5e-5, which closed only ~0.0015 nats of holdout policy KL per slot once the sharper targets opened a ~0.12-nat gap; restored for slot 3 on) and at most 16 rows per game carry a value target (value term scaled by the value-row share). Gates search 4 worlds like self-play (eval_worlds 4), and the opponent pool no longer includes the PPO seed gen__azv0. Everything else matches the default plan's az-league phase: 12 rotations of the exhaustive 10-deck self-play matrix + 24 rotating vs-scripted:hard cells per slot, game-uniform sampler at 50 rows/game over the auto (2x new shards) window, gated every 2 slots. Watch the az-train 'search-posterior entropy' line (9-30 run: 0.78 -> 0.90 nats) and the per-batch kl term; then the final baseline compares against the earlier az:gen baselines.
